hypothesis: The causal options implied-volatility surface of one crypto (EVAL-71 near-ATM IV level / put-call skew, expanding-z-scored) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized volatility of the OTHER crypto, reconstructed from the real Deribit option trade tape and real perp candles of both underlyings, beyond the target's own surface (partial-over-own-surface IC > 0). Tested on the already-acquired real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-71 + cross-asset common-bar floor.

protocol.title: Cross-asset options implied-volatility surface lead-lag spillover -> subsequent forward realized volatility: wrapper-free rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-71/73 (own-asset surface -> own-asset forward RV) and EVAL-77 (contemporaneous cross-sectional basis -> RV spread): the same Spearman rank-IC statistic and all sealed signal reconstructions reused verbatim, but a distinct, on-charter signal x target cell — the *cross-asset temporal* leader surface vs the *target* forward RV; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the temporal cross-asset complement to EVAL-71/73 (own-asset surface -> own RV) and EVAL-77 (contemporaneous basis -> spread); none measured leader surface vs the other asset's forward RV
protocol.signal: causal options-implied-vol surface (near-ATM IV level / put-call skew) z (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars + EVAL-61 expanding_zscore, end-of-bar k)
protocol.target_detail: target forward realized volatility = sqrt(mean(r^2)) over the TARGET's next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k); the subsequent realized vol of the OTHER crypto
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(leader_signal_z_k, target_fwd_rv_k) over common bar timestamps (H1: IC > 0); plus a partial Spearman rho(., . | target own surface z) as an incremental-over-own-surface control
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, for EACH target underlying, at least one incoming-spillover config (from the other asset; bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, partial-over-own-surface IC > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS). Per-direction detail is reported so a one-directional spillover is not misread as bidirectional.

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the target forward-RV series

floor.note: EVAL-83 consumes each underlying's causal options-surface series (real option trade tape for the IV surface, real perp candles for forward RV) and requires cross-asset overlap. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to EACH underlying, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with a cross-asset common-bar floor (>= min_common_bars_per_pair common bar timestamps between each ordered pair on the coarser 300 s grid). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
